wt_criterion: A design clears the WT arm when, over 3 independent draws per state under the same sampling setting and the same pocket constraint, BOTH of: (1) median buried_area_peptide on VVVGAGGVGK is at least 30% lower than on VVVGADGVGK, and (2) median position-6 heavy-atom contacts (all atoms, backbone included) is at least 30% lower. Strict separation (max over WT draws < min over G12D draws, for both quantities) is recorded alongside as the stronger read. The disappearance of Asp6 side-chain contacts on WT is excluded: glycine has no side chain, so that loss is true by construction and carries no information. No ipTM quantity enters this criterion.
